prayer: PRAYER: Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS Act, to direct the learned Second Additional Sessions cum PCR Court, Tirunelveli District (Special Court for SC/ST Act Cases) to consider the Bail application of the petitioner on the same day on merits in the even of her surrender in connection with crime No. 360 of 2026 on the file of the 2nd respondent.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

R. Vijayakumar, J.:— The present petition has been filed by the sole accused in crime No. 360 of 2026, on the file of the second respondent police seeking a direction as against the trial court to consider the bail application of the petitioner on the same day of surrender.

2. Considering the averments in the petition, there shall be a direction to the Second Additional Sessions cum PCR Court, Tirunelveli District (Special Court for SC/ST Act Cases), to consider the bail application of the petitioner on the same day of surrender in crime No. 360 of 2026, after giving due opportunity to the defacto complainant.

3. The petitioner shall surrender before the concerned Court on or before 15-6-2026.

4. With the above said observations, this Criminal Original Petition stands allowed.
